title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 4
description: Experiment 4 of the Brain, Body, and Behavior Dataset (BBBD) contains multimodal recordings from 43 participants who watched short educational videos while EEG, EOG, ECG, respiration, pupil size, gaze, and head position were recorded. Session 1 was an attentive condition with factual multiple-choice questions after each video. Session 2 was a distracted condition in which participants silently counted backwards in steps of 7. Questionnaires, including the ASRS adult ADHD symptom checklist and stimulus-related knowledge questions, are provided.
methods_description: Participants watched five to six instructional videos in random order under attentive and distracted conditions. EEG was recorded as BDF files, alongside EOG, ECG, respiration, eye tracking (gaze, pupil, blinks, saccades), and head position. Memory and domain-knowledge questions and the ASRS questionnaire were administered.
